rec.name: Announcement Bar (Benefits, Reviews.io, Countdown, Dismissible Promo Bar)

what.text: A custom, theme-portable Shopify section placed at the top of the page. It combines up to three stacked layers. (1) A main bar with benefit messages (icon + text, optional small CTA button) or a live Reviews.io rating block (average score, review count and the Reviews.io logo). (2) An optional countdown timer bar with text before and after the timer. (3) An optional additional promo bar with a link that visitors can dismiss with an X. The bar can be sticky and can be restricted to specific page types. The reference screenshot shows a green gradient bar with '4.68 / 5 positive Bewertungen' and the Reviews.io logo, then two benefits ('Free shipping from €49' and '100-day money-back guarantee'), then a purple promo bar ('Secure our sets at a special price – also perfect as a gift') with a close X.

why.text: The first screen the visitor sees carries the key trust and value signals: free-shipping threshold, risk-free guarantee and a live review score. This reduces purchase anxiety and perceived risk right away and keeps those messages visible while scrolling when the bar is sticky. A countdown or promo message adds urgency and highlights offers. Because the extra bar can be dismissed, it avoids annoying returning visitors, and the message stays out of sight for 7 days after dismissal.

how.text: Create a snippet 'announcement-reviewsio.liquid', which fetches the average rating and review count from the public Reviews.io timeline API using the store key from the block settings. Create a section file 'announcement-bar.liquid' with blocks of type 'message' (icon SVG, text, link, optional button) and 'reviews-io-widget'. The section also contains a countdown timer (show_timer: text before/after, link, colours) and an additional bar (text, link, colours, close icon). Visibility and sticky behaviour are resolved in Liquid via template.name (all / home / product / collection). Sticky behaviour is set per device: sticky, sticky_desktop or sticky_mobile. Position uses 'position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 5' with a breakpoint at 741px, and CSS variables expose the sticky state to the theme (--enable-sticky-announcement-bar). Layout: with two messages they sit 50/50 and the Reviews.io block is full-width and centred, ordered first on mobile. With a single block the content is centred at 100%. The dismiss click hides the additional bar and stores a timestamp in localStorage; the bar stays hidden for 7 days. Built from scratch because the old announcement code was scattered across the theme. Estimated effort was 8–12 hours (KVA).

items: Design: background colour, text colour (separate for timer and additional bar), button background and text colour
Texts via Shopify text fields
Custom icons via SVG paste, with a link to an SVG converter (Flaticon) under the field
Variant 1: two benefit blocks (text + icon each)
Variant 2: Reviews.io rating block (store key, link, text, toggle for total review count)
Variant 3: countdown timer (text before/after, link, colours)
Variant 4: text-only message
Optional small CTA button per message (text, link, colours)
Additional bar: text, link, background and text colour, optional dismiss (7-day localStorage)
Visibility: all pages / home / product / collection
Sticky pages: all / home / product / collection
Sticky position: sticky / desktop only / mobile only
Show/hide toggle for the whole section
Requested but not confirmed in the code: adjustable height, desktop/mobile spacing split, separate desktop/mobile colours with split colours on mobile, default icon library

dependencies.text: Needs a Shopify theme with a 'container' class and a '--container-gutter' CSS variable (built on the Focal theme, with the animation behaviour from the existing theme). A Reviews.io account and store key are required for the rating variant (public API, no app needed). The announcement-reviewsio snippet must be created. Icons must be pasted as inline SVG. The 'shopify-section--announcement-bar' wrapper class is assumed. Known code issues: typo 'section.settiings.additional_link' (additional bar link never renders) and localStorage key inconsistency (get/remove use different keys). The timer element '#announcement_timer' has no countdown JS in the supplied file, so the timer logic may live elsewhere in the theme.

items: Conversion rate
Click-through rate on bar links and CTA button
Free-shipping threshold / AOV
Bounce rate and scroll depth on PDP
Promo bar dismissal rate
Revenue per session (promo/timer campaigns)
